description: This file defines the JavaValueFieldDefinition class, a specialized implementation of a JSON field definition supporting arbitrary Java values for JSON serialization/deserialization within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes factory methods for instantiation and overrides for value extraction.

classes.name: JavaValueFieldDefinition
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractJsonFieldDefinition, representing a JSON field definition for arbitrary Java values supported by JSON, with static factory methods and an override for retrieving Java type values.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new JavaValueFieldDefinition instance with specified pointer, type, check function, mapping function, and optional markers.

methods.name: getAsJavaType
methods.description: Overrides method to extract Java type value from a JsonValue, returning null if JSON value is null, otherwise applying the mapping function.
